report.verdict: Strong senior backend experience, but the management track Cobalt Pay requires isn't shown.
write_up: Cobalt Pay is hiring an engineering manager, while your resume shows a senior backend engineer who mentors others. Your payouts and ledger work is directly relevant, but a recruiter can't see the direct-report management the role requires. I'm reading your resume for Senior Backend Engineer, where it makes a much stronger case.

Your balance API line is a great model: it names the latency problem, the change you made, and the before and after. The rest of the Lumen Ledger role also makes your work tangible, from payout volume to a zero-downtime ledger migration. Your experience leads, and the dates are easy to follow.

For senior backend roles, this is a strong resume and is unlikely to be the thing holding you back. For Cobalt Pay, move your mentoring and incident-review work higher, and add direct management work if you've done it. The role's requirements and the competition for it will still matter.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. You give the recruiter the technical decision and a clear measure of what changed, without making them guess how the two connect.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 5
cards.line: Mentor two mid-level engineers through code review and design docs
cards.cannot_tell: For a manager role, direct-report responsibilities would show a step beyond mentoring. Add them only if you've held them.

fit.why: Your headline and current role center on senior backend work in payouts, the ledger and payments operations.
fit.level: senior, leads technical projects and mentors two mid-level engineers
fit.note: Your payouts, ledger migration, mentoring and incident-review work match the team's work. Bring the mentoring and operations lines higher for this application, and add management responsibilities only if you've held them.
